itemListElement.name: Boutique Marketing: How to Bring Local Foot Traffic Through the Door

mainEntity.name: How can I get more foot traffic to my boutique?

acceptedAnswer.text: Be easy to find and easy to trust. Keep your Google listing accurate, with the real address and current hours, keep the window fresh, ask every happy customer for a review and partner with nearby shops.

mainEntity.name: Can I pay Google to rank my boutique higher on the map?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Google says there is no way to request or pay for a better local ranking. You can complete your profile, earn reviews and keep your information accurate, but you cannot buy the position.

mainEntity.name: Can I offer a discount for a Google review?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Google classes offering free or discounted goods in exchange for reviews as fake and misleading content, and it is strictly prohibited. Ask every customer the same way and let the review be honest.

mainEntity.name: Does my boutique need a Google Business Profile if I also sell online?

acceptedAnswer.text: If customers can visit your shop, yes. A real storefront address qualifies for a profile, while virtual offices and P.O. boxes do not. Keep the profile tied to the storefront.

mainEntity.name: Is Instagram enough to bring customers to a local boutique?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can support the store, but we have no verified data on how much it drives foot traffic. Use it to show new arrivals and send people to your address and hours, and keep your Google listing accurate alongside it.
